column2: 120 strings: 90 pass, 28 warn, 2 fail. Fails: #12 (catalogue provenance reattributed to WHO IRIS in the disclaimer banner) and #27 (DSpace 'Bundle' rendered as 'Package', a different DSpace term). Warns are mostly systematic terminology drift: DSpace 'item' consistently back-translated as 'record' (17 strings; major at #58 where it collides with the 'Metadata record' column), 'ingested' as 'imported' (6), project term 'bean' as 'task' (2), 'Browse' as 'Overview' (2), plus 'kind'->'type', 'referenced' state badge->'by reference', 'Source of record'->'Original source', and render->display (#76). All placeholders and HTML tags survived intact. Declined to count as drift: 'upstream' -> 'at the original source' (consistent, meaning kept), 'rendered' -> 'created' for covers/renderings, 'withheld' -> 'not shown' (context makes the deliberate withholding clear), 'recorded/captured' -> 'specified/retrieved', 'Permanent' -> 'Persistent' URI, 'Search' -> 'Find', 'live' -> 'active', 'mocks' -> 'reproduces', 'About' -> 'About the repository', label-colon restructurings for plural agreement, dropped articles in the glossary terms (116, 119 remain distinct), and lower-casing of WHO office names.
